# Persistent Wiki

A persistent wiki is a compiled knowledge layer that accumulates understanding over time instead of re-deriving it on every question.

## Signals

- Cross-references already exist before the next question arrives.
- Contradictions are flagged explicitly instead of silently overwritten.
- The synthesis becomes a compounding artifact rather than ephemeral chat output.
